product.title: Triple Body Butter - Rose
product.descriptionHtml:
• DYU Triple Body Butter - Rose blends cocoa, mango, and shea butter with coconut oil and rose absolute to deliver deep, lasting hydration while leaving skin soft, smooth, and beautifully scented.
  • Infused with Rose Centifolia Absolute, this body butter soothes the senses with a gentle floral aroma while helping calm inflammation and restore the skin's natural glow and suppleness.
  • Cocoa and mango butter work together to nourish dry, rough skin and provide a rich, creamy texture that melts on contact and absorbs easily without feeling greasy or sticky.
  • Shea butter and coconut oil offer intense moisturization, protecting against dryness, improving elasticity, and helping to repair damaged skin from environmental stressors and pollutants.
  • Enriched with vitamin E, this chemical-free body moisturiser promotes skin repair and rejuvenation, making it perfect for daily use on dry areas like elbows, knees, hands, and feet.
